desc: With state of the art precision machinery, this historical revolver is more accurate and reliable. The Rough Rider locks up securely and has perfect timing to provide you with optimum accuracy. No short cuts are taken. The Rough Rider barrel is machined, micro-threaded, then it is inserted into the frame at a controlled depth. This regulates the barrel to cylinder gap and provides you with maximum power. Frame mounted hammer block with red indicator for extra protection.
